name: Scientific Research Instruments Company Pvt Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: None -- the company primarily focuses on laboratory equipment for research and development, not directly on semiconductors
india_angle: SRICO has a service network across India and provides customer support in product application, consultation, system integration, installation, maintenance, and technical service.
summary: Scientific Research Instruments Company Pvt Ltd (SRICO) is a laboratory equipment provider, offering solutions from internationally reputed manufacturers for research and development and quality control across various industries. Their focus is on delivering world-class equipment and support services, primarily in the fields of academic research, pharmaceuticals, chemical engineering, life sciences, and biotechnology.
